items.finding: mcp_tokens carried a separate companies column although ADR-0008 models the company allow-list inside scope.
items.fix: fixed: the column is gone and scope holds the allow-list, as the ADR says

items.finding: Drizzle was a dependency used only for types; every repository issued raw SQL, while ADR-0004 names 'Drizzle ORM with migrations'.
items.fix: fixed: runs, verdicts and evidence now query through the Drizzle builder, with raw SQL only where Postgres needs it (partition DDL); the migration runner stays hand-rolled because partitioning, the append-only trigger and the unlogged cache are not expressible by a generator, and the .sql files remain the database's source of truth

items.finding: The drift test compares table names only, so a renamed column would drift silently.
items.fix: answered: recorded as a follow-up to compare information_schema.columns against the Drizzle definitions

items.finding: DoD item 1's literal command failed: pnpm --filter runs the script from the package directory, and the vitest workspace lives at the repository root.
items.fix: fixed: the package's own test:integration script now runs vitest with --root ../.., so the DoD's literal command passes (integration.log)

items.finding: The literal docker compose plus migrate sequence failed once with ECONNRESET because the container was still starting.
items.fix: fixed: the CLI waits for the database to accept a connection, and migrate.log shows the sequence green on the first try

items.finding: The full gate now runs Testcontainers and therefore needs Docker; --fast stays Docker-free.
items.fix: answered: judged acceptable by the reviewer and recorded in Progress and the PR

items.finding: source_servers.replica is constrained to true so a primary can never be listed.

summary: Schema, migrations, and tenant-scoped repositories faithfully implement architecture.md §5/§6 and ADR-0004/0008/0011, with solid integration tests and no boundary or test-loosening issues.
